analysis.title: FX Technical Analysis - Mixed technical signs in S&P 500
key_insights: S&P 500 spot ref 7580.07 (30 Oct close), down from 7623.68 at the 26 Oct review. It filled the 22 Oct gap-down but failed to hold above the 20d SMA (7729.90) and gapped lower on 30 Oct to close within the Cloud. UBS calls the technical picture mixed.
UBS expects an S&P 500 rebound to fill the 30 Oct gap-down at 7690.94, but is skeptical of upside after three failures to hold above the 20d SMA. Price bounced off Cloud support at 7565.93 on 30 Oct.

S&P 500 stays bullish short term, with a target of 7829.00 (reached but not broken), then 8085.48. A bearish outlook needs a close below 7257.33. Resistances are 7644 and 7739. Supports are 7565 and 7257.

Nasdaq Composite spot ref 25,437.00, down from 25,955.34 at the 26 Oct review. It failed to break above the Cloud, closed below it, converged toward the lower Bollinger and gapped lower on 29 and 30 Oct.

UBS expects Nasdaq to rebound and fill the gaps, up to 26,414.92, but the rebound is unlikely to break above the Cloud unless Nasdaq pushes higher. Outlook stays bullish with targets of 27,548.13 then 28,367.97. A bearish outlook needs a close below 24,425.34.

Hang Seng spot ref 23,441.63, up from 23,244.62, in line with UBS's rebound expectation. Outlook is bearish with a target of 22,668.35. An extended rebound is expected to fill the 22 Oct gap-down at 23,620.10.

Hang Seng has repeatedly failed to hold above the Cloud since January and failed to hold above the 20d SMA (24,034.57). UBS would turn neutral on a break above the Cloud (24,963.23) and needs a close above 26,836.66 for a bullish outlook, targeting 28,056.10.
CSI 300 spot ref 4020.86, down from 4085.94, against UBS's rebound expectation. Outlook is bearish. The 4037.94 target was reached on 22 Oct and the target is now cut to 3829.25, then 3704.44.

CSI 300 carries near-term rebound risk from unfilled gap-downs on 24 and 28 Sep, implying an advance to 4513.45. A move higher without testing the lower Bollinger (3938.97) also raises rebound risk. A close above the Cloud (4548.92) would turn the outlook bullish, targeting 5061.51 then 5143.84.

Nikkei 225 spot ref 63,245.65, down from 64,492.03, against UBS's rebound expectation. It is losing upside traction after a downside exhaustion candlestick on 23 Oct. UBS expects a rebound to 67,533.10 to fill the 15 Oct gap-down, which would lift it back above the Cloud.
Nikkei outlook is bullish with a target of 72,831.73. A close below 59,332.43 would turn it bearish, targeting 54,487.32.

EURO Stoxx 50 spot ref 6131.31, up from 6068.22, against UBS's expectation. Price failed to hold above the neckline for the fourth time and above the 20d SMA (6167.11) for the third time. UBS reads a completed head and shoulders top and stays bearish.

EURO Stoxx 50 targets the pattern's textbook level of 5811.16, then 5762.15. UBS tolerates rebounds to 6365.40, above which the pattern is invalid. A bullish outlook needs a close above the Cloud (6384.91), targeting 6577.20.

Rheinmetall (UBS Buy, PT EUR 1,360) spot ref 1030.40. The technical outlook is bearish after a second failure to hold within the Cloud and easing upward momentum. UBS targets 933.00 (reached but not broken), then 774.60. A close above 1234.00 is needed for a bullish outlook, targeting 1352.50 then 1471.00.

SAP (UBS Neutral, PT EUR 210) spot ref 210.50, down from 212.35, in line with UBS's expectation of a near-term pullback. It bounced off the 20d SMA (200.59) on 28 Oct. The outlook is bullish with targets of 219.45 then 243.40, and declines are viewed as corrective.
SAP's bullish view is reversed on a close below the Cloud (support 172.37), which would target 130.86 then 120.00. Cloud support at 182.88 is the first bounce area.

market_movers.rationale: UBS fundamental rating is Buy, PT EUR 1,360, but the technical outlook is bearish with a target of 933.00, then 774.60. Rheinmetall's primary listing is in Germany. The report names no US ticker.
UBS rating is Neutral, PT EUR 210. The technical outlook is bullish with targets of 219.45 then 243.40, and a near-term pullback risk.

risk_factors: S&P 500 has failed three times to hold above the 20d SMA, and UBS is skeptical of upside prospects.
A close below 7257.33 on the S&P 500 or below 24,425.34 on the Nasdaq would turn UBS bearish.
EURO Stoxx 50 has completed a head and shoulders top and has failed to hold above the neckline four times.
A CSI 300 rebound toward 4513.45 is a risk to the bearish view, from unfilled gap-downs.
vol_and_positioning: The Nasdaq Composite has converged toward the lower Bollinger band and gapped lower on 29 and 30 Oct.
CSI 300 has yet to test its lower Bollinger band (3938.97). A move higher without that test raises the risk of a near-term rebound.
